market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI intraday already touched $110.90 today (April 30). Market resolves YES if any 1-min candle high in May reaches $110. Given current momentum and Iran-driven volatility, only a sharp pullback would prevent a touch in May; high probability YES.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Rapid de-escalation could collapse the risk premium before May.
